rules.statement: EBW supports selected project-confirmed arable and grassland areas managed for biodiversity objectives.

conditions.description: The measure is requested.
A project confirmation exists.

result.description: The area can be considered only within the project-confirmed EBW scope.

rules.statement: The EBW contract runs to 31 December 2028; start years 2023, 2024 and 2025 imply 6, 5 and 4 years respectively.

conditions.description: The start year is an available EBW entry year.

result.description: The required commitment duration is mapped by start year.

rules.statement: At least 1.00 ha of eligible area is required in the first participation year; thereafter at least one plot must be managed under EBW each participation year.

conditions.description: This is the first commitment year.
The first-year eligible area reaches 1.00 ha.

result.description: The first-year minimum is satisfied.

rules.statement: The competent coordination body issues the project confirmation for selected arable and grassland plots and sets plot-specific mandatory indicators.

conditions.description: A project confirmation is available.
The graphical EBW reference area exists.

result.description: Only the confirmed plots and their indicators define the operative scope.

rules.statement: Mandatory indicators in the project confirmation must be achieved for each applied plot; additional indicators are non-binding.

conditions.expression: every parcel in measure.project_confirmation.parcels has mandatory_indicators_met == true
conditions.description: Every confirmed plot meets its mandatory indicators.

result.description: The mandatory indicator obligation is fulfilled.

rules.statement: Eligible plots needing regular care must be used or maintained at least every second year.

conditions.description: The required use or maintenance occurs at least every second year.

result.description: The regular-care obligation is fulfilled.

rules.statement: Plot-specific indicators must be continuously observed and recorded in the prescribed database structure.

conditions.description: The prescribed observation database is current.

result.description: The indicator recordkeeping requirement is fulfilled.

rules.statement: By 31 December 2026 the beneficiary must attend at least one regional networking meeting.

conditions.description: The application year is within the training deadline period.
At least one meeting was attended by the deadline.

result.description: The training obligation is fulfilled by the deadline.

rules.statement: A materially active person involved in farm management may attend the networking meeting.

conditions.description: The substitute participant is materially active and involved in management.

result.description: Delegated attendance is accepted subject to the personal binding rule.

rules.statement: Written attendance evidence must be supplied on request and one event cannot be double-counted.

conditions.description: The event is not counted for multiple obligations.
Written attendance confirmation is available when required.

result.description: Attendance evidence and non-duplication are required.

rules.statement: The optional Regional Nature Conservation Plan surcharge is 250 EUR in 2023 and 270 EUR from 2024 per farm and year when requested and supported by annual confirmation.

conditions.description: The optional surcharge is requested.
The annual participation confirmation exists.

result.description: The annual farm surcharge is 270 EUR.

rules.statement: The Regional Nature Conservation Plan defines regional objectives and its required indicators are recorded in the project confirmation.

conditions.description: The responsible body confirms annual participation.

result.description: Regional planning and its plot indicators are part of the confirmation.

rules.statement: EBW and its optional regional-plan surcharge must be requested by 31 December before the following contract year.

conditions.description: The measures application was timely.

result.description: A valid following-year contract can be established.

rules.statement: The last EBW entry was funding year 2025; the regional-plan surcharge last entered for 2028.

conditions.description: The EBW entry year is not later than 2025.

result.description: The entry window is respected.

rules.statement: An EBW plot must carry code EBW and a corresponding EBW reference area must exist for payment.

conditions.description: The plot carries the EBW code.
The graphical EBW reference area is present.

result.description: The plot is technically claimable for EBW.

rules.statement: UBB or BIO may count eligible EBW fallows or listed grassland habitats toward biodiversity obligations only with the specified DIV/DIVSZ codes; project-confirmation obligations remain applicable.

conditions.description: UBB or BIO is also selected.
The required biodiversity code is present.

result.description: Cross-credit is allowed only with the specified codes and confirmation obligations.

rules.statement: EBW may be combined with Naturschutz at farm level; the regional-plan surcharge is paid only once per farm and participation year.

conditions.description: Both farm-level measures are selected.
Only one regional surcharge award is recorded.

result.description: The combination is allowed and the surcharge is not duplicated.

rules.statement: If all farm land is in EBW and UBB or BIO is also selected, at least 0.15 ha is required on field pieces larger than 5.00 ha.

conditions.description: All eligible farm land is in EBW.
The field piece exceeds 5.00 ha.

result.description: At least 0.15 ha must be separately available as DIV/DIVSZ where no EBW plot is countable.

rules.statement: GLÖZ 4 buffer strips and, through 2024, GLÖZ 8 fallows are not EBW-premium eligible on the affected part.

conditions.description: The affected subarea is a GLÖZ 4 or eligible-period GLÖZ 8 area.
The GLÖZ 8 transition period has not ended.

result.description: The subarea is excluded from EBW payment.

rules.statement: EBW arable fallows are eligible up to 25% of farm arable area, but at least 2.00 ha is eligible under the stated floor.

conditions.description: The farm arable area is known.

result.description: The operational cap is the greater of 25% of arable area and 2.00 ha.

rules.statement: EBW areas are not premium-combinable with another measure on the same area except Natura 2000 and listed landscape-element compensation.

conditions.description: The other title is one of the listed exceptions or none.

result.description: Only the stated same-area premium combinations are allowed.

rules.statement: The EBW base premium is determined by project-confirmed habitat, conservation status and, for meadows, difficulty class; complete rates are data-backed.

conditions.description: The project-confirmed premium key is present in the rate table.
The conservation status is listed.

result.description: The applicable rate is read from the complete Anhang-K rate data.

rules.statement: The accepted EBW indicator codes and thresholds are the complete Anhang-K catalog, including arable, grassland, animal, bird and neophyte indicators.

conditions.description: The selected code is present in the catalog.

result.description: The code can be evaluated against its source text and project-specific parameters.

rules.statement: EBBA01 is 108 EUR/ha and once per area for documented qualifying effort; EBBA02 is 162 EUR/ha from 2025 for very-good conservation status.

conditions.description: The first special-effort surcharge is documented and not already awarded.
The second tier's status and year conditions hold.

result.description: The applicable special-effort surcharge is 108 or 162 EUR/ha.

rules.statement: The EBHG habitat surcharge is 108 EUR/ha only when at least 50% of the plot is in the protection layer.

conditions.description: At least half of the plot is in the Schutzgutflächen layer.

result.description: The habitat surcharge is available when the GIS and share conditions are met.

rules.statement: EBW additions are fully premium eligible in 2024 and 2025; later additions are limited to 50% of the 2025 base, with up to 5 ha always allowed.

conditions.expression: measure.application_year in {2024,2025} or measure.accession_area_ha <= max(50% of measure.area_2025_ha,5)
conditions.description: The accession is within the year-specific premium limit.

result.description: The year-specific accession premium limit is applied.

rules.statement: A yearly EBW area reduction is permitted up to 5%, up to 5.00 ha, and in any event 0.50 ha; exceeding the limits triggers repayment for the differential area.

conditions.expression: measure.reduction_ha <= min(5% of measure.prior_year_measure_area_ha,5) or measure.reduction_ha <= 0.5
conditions.description: The reduction stays within the tolerance.

result.description: Within tolerance no repayment follows; otherwise the differential area is repayable.

rules.statement: By 31 December 2025 EBW could be converted into Naturschutz or vice versa without repayment for the original measure; higher-value obligations apply for the remaining term.

conditions.description: The conversion is requested by the final date.
The target is the reciprocal measure.

result.description: The higher-value measure's obligations govern the remaining term.

rules.statement: A running EBW obligation may be taken over by another non-participating farm by 15 April, or 17 April in 2023 and 2028, subject to AMA approval and the 50% expansion limit.

conditions.description: The takeover is timely.
The takeover does not expand the obligation by more than 50%.

result.description: The takeover continues for the remaining term if AMA approves it.

rules.statement: Violations can cause warning or 2%, 5%, 10%, 25%, 50% or 100% reductions; two 100% reductions cause exclusion and repayment, and from 2027 warning becomes 1% retention.

conditions.description: A violation is established by administrative or on-site control.

result.description: The measure-specific sanction scale applies, including possible repayment and exclusion.

rules.statement: All measure premiums are modulated by total farm area: 100% to 200 ha, 90% over 200 to 300 ha, 85% over 300 to 1,000 ha, and 75% above 1,000 ha.

conditions.description: Total farm area is available for progressive modulation.

result.description: The weighted modulation factor is applied to all EBW premiums.

rules.statement: In 2026 Acker-Biodiversitätsflächen also in EBW remain governed by the project confirmation; the general drought permission does not override EBW obligations.

conditions.description: The drought year and EBW overlap apply.
The proposed use follows the EBW project confirmation.

result.description: The 2026 general biodiversity exception is not an override for EBW areas.
